purpose: Synchronize provider-backed artifacts with bounded local materialization while preserving exact identity, authority, freshness, durable common-baseline conflict safety, privacy, storage limits, and machine-readable receipts.
core_owns: binding validation and semantic artifact identity
adapters_own: provider locator resolution from protected runtime state
provider-specific watch/poll APIs and failure translation
integrations_own: artifact-continuity-preflight activation before local artifact creation/return
Entire session/checkpoint provenance without making Entire transfer engine or scheduler
agent/repository hooks invoking artifact-sync at declared checkpoints
consumer-specific semantic bindings and protected locator resolution
forbidden_core_assumptions: one repository layout or consuming product
tracked provider URLs or provider file identifiers
persistent local copies as the default
conflict detection without a recoverable last common verified baseline
raw-byte replacement of provider-native document formats
proof_ceiling: Activation/preflight, binding/receipt/baseline contracts, privacy/storage policy, deterministic validators, and handoff semantics are defined. Rust implementation and live provider behavior remain unproven.
next_transition: After current-runtime contract/review repair passes CI, implement the Rust CLI against the revised v1 contracts and preflight activation.
